slots.name: misdemeanor count
slots.sentence: The NFL's decision comes after Jacobs was charged Aug. 27 with two misdemeanors relating to a May arrest – one for battery and the other for criminal damage to property.

slots.name: initial charge count
slots.sentence: Jacobs faced five counts after his initial arrest: battery (domestic abuse), criminal damage to property (domestic abuse), disorderly conduct (domestic abuse), strangulation and suffocation, and intimidation of a victim.

Josh Jacobs September 10 plea and deferred judgment

slots.name: misdemeanor charges count
slots.sentence: Jacobs pleaded no contest to misdemeanor battery and criminal damage to property during a court appearance on Thursday, Sept. 10.

slots.name: fine amount
slots.sentence: As part of an announced plea deal, the 28-year-old was found guilty on the charge of battery and ordered to pay a $1,000 fine plus costs.

slots.name: deferred judgment status
slots.sentence: For the second charge of criminal damage to property, Jacobs reached a deferred judgment agreement.

slots.name: evidence seal status
slots.sentence: The presiding judge temporarily sealed the evidence from the case on Sept. 10 after Jacobs' no-contest plea.

slots.name: deferred judgment period
slots.sentence: He will have to meet a list of conditions for the next 12 months in order to have that charge dismissed by the state: no further criminal acts, no contact with the victim, supervision, counseling and restitution payment to the victim.
